pages.text: Pocket peeks out of the backpack. Pink blossom drifts down like soft snow. "Hello, Seoul," says Pocket. Look and look.
Two guards stand very still at the palace gate. Their robes are red and blue and gold. Pocket stands still, too.
Skip, skip, skip! Three children in hanbok skip by. Pink, blue and yellow sleeves swing. "Hello, Seoul," says Pocket. Look and look.
Pocket peeks over the roofs of the old hanok houses. The tiles curve up like gentle waves.
The Han River sparkles and sparkles in the warm afternoon sun. "Hello, Seoul," says Pocket. Look and look.
Mmm! Pocket smells tteokbokki. Warm, red and chewy, it bubbles in a big pan. Puff, puff, goes the steam.
Whoosh! The subway train hums along, quiet and smooth. Pocket sits on a seat and rocks, rocks, rocks.
Up the hill, up the hill, the sky turns coral and pink. "Hello, Seoul," says Pocket. Look and look.
A magpie sits on a branch, black and white and round. He tucks in his tail. Pocket tucks in an ear.
N Seoul Tower begins to glow on its hill. Lights come on, one by one. "Hello, Seoul," says Pocket. Look and look.
The lights twinkle and twinkle. Pocket yawns a big, slow yawn. One ear droops. Then the other.
Pocket is tucked up in the hotel room, fast asleep. Goodnight, Pocket. Goodnight, Seoul.
